SELECT pd.*, dt.name AS template_name, dt.template_type,
                        dt.requires_patient_signature, dt.requires_tutor_signature, dt.requires_doctor_signature,
                        dt.requires_witness1_signature, dt.requires_witness2_signature
                   FROM patient_documents pd
                   LEFT JOIN document_templates dt
                          ON dt.id_document_template COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = pd.id_document_template COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci
                  WHERE pd.id_business COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = :_id_business COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci
                    AND pd.id_person COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = :_id_person COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci
                    AND pd.active = 1
                  ORDER BY pd.created_at DESC, pd.id_patient_document DESC LIMIT :_limit OFFSET :_offset

SELECT
                    p.id_prescription,
                    p.folio,
                    p.status,
                    p.issue_date,
                    p.issued_at,
                    p.cancelled_at,
                    p.id_person,
                    TRIM(CONCAT(IFNULL(person.name, ''), ' ', IFNULL(person.surname, ''))) AS patient_name,
                    person.birthday AS patient_birthday,
                    person.age AS patient_age,
                    p.issuer_doctor_id,
                    COALESCE(p.doctor_name_snapshot, dpp.professional_name, doctor.name) AS doctor_name,
                    p.created_by,
                    creator.name AS created_by_name,
                    p.issued_by,
                    issuer.name AS issued_by_name,
                    p.cancelled_by,
                    canceller.name AS cancelled_by_name,
                    p.diagnosis,
                    p.notes,
                    p.cancellation_reason,
                    (
                        SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(pi.generic_name ORDER BY pi.sort_order SEPARATOR ', ')
                          FROM prescription_item pi
                         WHERE pi.id_prescription COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = p.id_prescription COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci
                           AND pi.id_business COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = p.id_business COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci
                    ) AS medications
                   FROM prescription p
                   INNER JOIN person ON person.id_person COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = p.id_person COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AND person.id_business COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = p.id_business COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci
                   LEFT JOIN login doctor ON doctor.id_login COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = p.issuer_doctor_id COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci
                   LEFT JOIN doctor_professional_profile dpp ON dpp.id_login COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = p.issuer_doctor_id COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AND dpp.id_business COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = p.id_business COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci
                   LEFT JOIN login creator ON creator.id_login COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = p.created_by COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci
                   LEFT JOIN login issuer ON issuer.id_login COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = p.issued_by COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci
                   LEFT JOIN login canceller ON canceller.id_login COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = p.cancelled_by COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci
                  WHERE p.id_business COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = :_id_business COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AND p.active = 1 AND p.id_person COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = :_id_person COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci
                  ORDER BY p.issue_date DESC, p.created_at DESC, p.id_prescription DESC LIMIT :_limit OFFSET :_offset

SELECT tp.*, creator.name AS created_by_name, editor.name AS updated_by_name, closer.name AS closed_by_name
            FROM treatment_plan tp
            LEFT JOIN login creator ON creator.id_login COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = tp.created_by COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AND creator.id_business COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = tp.id_business COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci
            LEFT JOIN login editor ON editor.id_login COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = tp.updated_by COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AND editor.id_business COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = tp.id_business COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci
            LEFT JOIN login closer ON closer.id_login COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = tp.closed_by COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AND closer.id_business COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = tp.id_business COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci
            WHERE tp.id_business COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = :business COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AND tp.id_person COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = :patient COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AND tp.active = 1
            AND tp.status <> 'active'
            ORDER BY tp.created_at DESC, tp.id_treatment_plan DESC LIMIT :limit OFFSET :offset

SELECT pt.* FROM patient_treatment pt WHERE pt.id_business COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = :business COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci
            AND pt.id_person COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = :patient COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AND pt.active = 1 AND pt.id_treatment_plan IN (:planIds) ORDER BY pt.created_at DESC, pt.id_patient_treatment DESC

SELECT pd.*, link.id_treatment_plan, link.consent_snapshot_json, link.prepared_by
            FROM treatment_plan_consent_document link INNER JOIN patient_documents pd ON pd.id_patient_document = link.id_patient_document
                AND pd.id_business = link.id_business AND pd.id_person = link.id_person
            WHERE link.id_business COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = :business COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AND link.id_person COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = :patient COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AND pd.active = 1 AND link.id_treatment_plan IN (:planIds) AND pd.status <> 'CANCELADO'
            AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM treatment_plan_consent_document newer
                INNER JOIN patient_documents newer_pd ON newer_pd.id_patient_document = newer.id_patient_document
                    AND newer_pd.id_business = newer.id_business AND newer_pd.id_person = newer.id_person
                WHERE newer.id_business = link.id_business AND newer.id_person = link.id_person AND newer.id_treatment_plan = link.id_treatment_plan
                    AND newer_pd.active = 1 AND newer_pd.status <> 'CANCELADO'
                    AND (newer.prepared_at > link.prepared_at OR (newer.prepared_at = link.prepared_at AND newer.id_patient_document > link.id_patient_document))) ORDER BY link.prepared_at DESC, pd.id_patient_document DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS firstVisitPatients, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM appointment later_appointment
             WHERE later_appointment.id_business COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = :_id_business COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci
               AND later_appointment.id_person COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = first_visits.id_person COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci
               
               AND later_appointment.active = 1 AND later_appointment.status = 'completed'
               AND TIMESTAMP(later_appointment.appointment_date, later_appointment.start_time) > first_visits.firstAppointmentAt
               AND TIMESTAMP(later_appointment.appointment_date, later_appointment.start_time) <= :_to
               AND TIMESTAMP(later_appointment.appointment_date, later_appointment.start_time) <= NOW()
        ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS retainedPatients FROM (
            SELECT a.id_person, MIN(TIMESTAMP(a.appointment_date, a.start_time)) AS firstAppointmentAt FROM appointment a
             WHERE a.id_business COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci = :_id_business COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci 
               AND a.active = 1 AND a.id_person IS NOT NULL AND a.status = 'completed'
               AND TIMESTAMP(a.appointment_date, a.start_time) <= NOW() GROUP BY a.id_person
        ) first_visits WHERE first_visits.firstAppointmentAt >= :_from AND first_visits.firstAppointmentAt <= :_to
